I'm considering whether D62 is buried or solvent-exposed within this helical bundle structure, since aspartate residues are typically found on the surface. I'm checking the coordinates of the side chain atoms to estimate how many neighboring atoms fall within a close distance, which would indicate burial.

Checking a few nearby residues, I notice Arg46's guanidinium group sits close to D62's carboxylate, suggesting they form a salt bridge — roughly 2.7-3.6 Å apart. Since Asp-Arg salt bridges commonly occur on protein surfaces and this is a small 116-residue helical bundle, I conclude D62 is most likely solvent-exposed rather than buried.
